Params: text (required, up to 20,000 characters), top (number of candidates, default 3). Price: $0.0025 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"text":"Bonjour, je voudrais réserver une table pour deux personnes ce soir."}.
